title: The carousel hack that saves hours every week
description:
Set up one Claude Project and it writes your full Instagram carousel from a single topic, the hook and every slide, in about a minute. The fastest AI content creation workflow for creators who post carousels. This Claude AI tutorial hands you the exact instruction block that turns Claude into your own AI carousel generator. #Shorts #ClaudeAI #InstagramCarousel
Get the instruction block here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P9AyLAayzCCPNClvHQeWzz3RACyi3kH-TqDXY-0_NXQ/edit?usp=sharing
